Both plots share a common x-axis labeled “Steps,” which is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at intervals of 100. A blue solid line, representing “Llama-On-Policy-Easy”, begins at approximately 0.0 at a step value of 0, then increases to approximately 0.32 at a step value of 500, with some oscillations. A red solid line, representing “Llama-LUFFY-Easy”, starts at approximately 0.0 at a step value of 0, increasing to approximately 0.39 at a step value of 500, also exhibiting some oscillations.

The bottom plot illustrates the relationship between steps and training rewards for two different models within a “Hard” training set. A blue solid line, representing “Llama-On-Policy-Hard”, starts at approximately 0.0 at a step value of 0 and increases to approximately 0.14 at a step value of 500, maintaining an overall steady incline with fluctuations. A red solid line, representing “Llama-LUFFY-Hard”, begins at approximately 0.0 at a step value of 0 and increases to approximately 0.20 at a step value of 500, with significant oscillations throughout.
